Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.customgame

Interface CustomGameService

public interface CustomGameService
Player-hosted custom games: listing, joining and moderating them.

Hosts draft and publish games through the custom games menu, when their perk tier allows Perk.CUSTOM_GAMES_CREATE (since 1.10.0); this service exposes the published games and the same join, cancel and terminate operations the menus use, so an addon can build its own listings or moderation tools. Each change of state fires CustomGameStateChangeEvent; a successful publication fires CustomGamePublishEvent.

Every method must be called on the main thread. Returned games are snapshots.

Since:
1.8.0

    • join

      @NotNull @NotNull CustomGameService.JoinResult join(@NotNull @NotNull org.bukkit.entity.Player player, @NotNull @NotNull UUID customGameId, @Nullable @Nullable String password)
      Puts a player - or, for a party leader, their whole party - into one specific custom game, exactly as choosing it in the custom games menu would.

      A password-protected game requires its password unless the player is its host; it is checked here, so pass what the player typed. Main thread only.

      Parameters:
      password - the password the player gave, or null when they gave none
      Returns:
      the outcome; CustomGameService.JoinResult.JOINING means the join was accepted and is underway
